title: Leju Robotics Puts 15 Humanoids on an Auto Parts Loading Line, Reporting About 98% Success
key_facts: Leju Robotics and parts maker Zhaofeng have 15 humanoid robots in routine operation on a parts loading line at Zhaofeng's No. 3 plant in Xiaoshan, Hangzhou; presented on 15 Oct 2026.
A Zhaofeng representative quoted by Securities Times said the robots cover 15 workstations and more than 10 part types with a loading success rate holding at 98%.
The deployment has run for more than two months, about 1,000 hours, helping produce more than 60,000 parts.
One loading cycle takes under 40 seconds against about 15 seconds for a skilled worker.
Zhaofeng's chairman said humanoids would need about 15 seconds before wider adoption, expected in six months to a year.
The companies are donating a loading dataset from real operation to the OpenLET community under the OpenAtom Foundation.
